title: MeshKit
description:
MeshKit, developed by HydroCouple (github.com/HydroCouple/Meshkit), is an open-source library for generating and checking unstructured two-dimensional meshes: constrained Delaunay triangulation, mixed triangle and quadrilateral meshes with mapped patches, size fields, bilinear terrain certificates, and streaming MKB and SMS 2DM file I/O. It provides Qt-free C++17 targets, optional Qt adapters, Python bindings and a command-line tool.

It includes the robust geometric predicates of Jonathan Richard Shewchuk, which are in the public domain.
